command: $p='.state\timeline\refresh.lock'; if(Test-Path $p){$pidText=(Get-Content $p -Raw).Trim(); Write-Output "LOCK_PID=$pidText"; Get-Item $p | Select-Object LastWriteTime,Length | Format-List; if($pidText -match '^\d+$'){Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=$pidText" | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,CreationDate,CommandLine | Format-List}} else {Write-Output 'NO_LOCK'}
